socketMode.description: Prefer Socket Mode (default). Set false for HTTP Events via httpHostToken.

master.description: 框架 master（Slack user id；AI/工具权限、endpoint 管理）。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (Slack user id; AI/tool permissions and endpoint management). endpoints[i].master can override this value.

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（弱于 master）。endpoints[i].trusted 可逐项追加

en.description: Framework trusted users, below master authority. endpoints[i].trusted can add users.

endpoints.description: 多账号：一个插件实例挂多个 endpoint。每项与顶层字段同构（id 必填，其余覆盖顶层）

master.description: 本 endpoint 的框架 master（Slack user id）；覆盖顶层 master

en.description: Framework masters for this endpoint (Slack user id), overriding the top-level master list.

trusted.description: 本 endpoint 的 trusted 列表

signingSecret.description: Required for HTTP Events API (socketMode: false)

streamProxy.description: Socket故障验收：WSS固定loopback TCP，API仍标准TLS直连

en.description: Socket fault-injection tests: pin WSS TCP to loopback while API requests retain direct standard TLS.

webApiProxy.description: 出站JSON Web API专用故障代理：仅slack.com:443，固定loopbackTCP，保留SNI和证书校验，与Socket代理独立；上传域名不适用

en.description: Fault proxy for outbound JSON Web APIs only: pin slack.com:443 TCP to loopback while preserving SNI and certificate validation. Independent of the Socket proxy; does not apply to upload hosts.
Multiple accounts: mount multiple endpoints in one plugin instance. Each entry uses the top-level fields; id is required and other fields override defaults.

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.
